_comment: Responses recorded from a real printer (ke-dev), for endpoints whose result keys static analysis cannot resolve. Provenance per entry. Never edited to look tidier: a value here is what the printer sent, redacted for privacy by the session that captured it. An endpoint belongs here ONLY if gen_firmware_api_responses.py reports it unresolved - an observed sample is weaker evidence than the source, so it never overrides a resolved answer.
